question: The Oudh Kisan Sabha was set up in the year______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**1920**__.

__
 
• **The Oudh Kisan Sabha was founded in 1920 by Baba Ram Chandra**__.

 __
 
• He was a trade unionist who gathered Oudh's farmers and led the first anti-landlord demonstration.
 
• **Jawaharlal Nehru, Baba Ramchandra and others** founded the Oudh Kisan Sabha, commonly known as the Oudh Kisan Sabha.
 
• It was established to oppose the zamindars and talukdars who demanded excessive taxes and rent.
